name: Fortellis Service Appointment
description: Documented structure of the Fortellis Service Appointment object as exposed via the Service Appointments API and Event Relay payloads.

fields.name: appointmentId
fields.description: Unique Fortellis identifier for the appointment record.

fields.name: scheduledStart
fields.description: Appointment start time in dealership local time.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lifecycle status: scheduled, checked-in, in-progress, completed, cancelled, no-show.

fields.name: serviceType
fields.description: Categorical service type (oil change, recall, repair, body, government test, etc.).

fields.name: advisor
fields.description: Service advisor assigned to the appointment.
